description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Awoken Azure Guardian], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Hydro Shock Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Azure Guardian
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Water abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Hydro Shock Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Hydro Shock after using three Water abilities, removed after triggering

description.name: Hydro Shock
description.text: One single ranged jump attack (5.28) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate, grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] to the user
